policy.classification_policy: conflict if opposing definite labels; otherwise any unresolved row makes group ambiguous
policy.classifier_policy: one row per sequence+amidation; exclude mixed, unresolved, or pending-note identities; no majority vote
policy.empty_chemistry_assumption: no modification recorded; not verified absent
policy.missing_chemistry_policy: exclude absent fields; accept present null/empty
policy.note_policy: nonempty notes require manual review; differing notes never pooled; notes do not prove causation or co-treatment
policy.regression_policy: median log10 MIC of single numeric rows within assay group; inspect classification conflicts separately
